subject: Assurance artifact corridor and owner commitments for Novus SIG pack
messages:
From: Lisa Wong <lisa.wong@novusfinancial.com>
To: karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com
Cc: procurement@novusfinancial.com
Date: Sun, 11 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Novus SIG questionnaire (Q2) — initial intake

Hi Karthik,

Thanks again for taking our SIG/assurance request. Attached is the questionnaire that procurement and InfoSec want filled out for our Q2 vendor intake (Novus RFP #42). We need a mapping of controls to evidence and an initial timeline for delivery.

Two early asks from our InfoSec lead:
- KMS/HSM provenance for customer key handling (even if using BYOK flows) — example format preferred is a signed attestation + timeline of key creation/rotation.
- A small sample bundle (2–3 artifacts) showing how you deliver logs and retention metadata (we'll keep copies).

Can you confirm a single intake point and the expected cadence for artifacts? We prefer an S3 staging link with hashed manifests and a short ship schedule.

Attachment: Novus_SIG_Q2_2027.xlsx (spreadsheet — questionnaire)

Best,
Lisa Wong
Sr. Vendor Risk Manager — Novus Financial
procurement@novusfinancial.com

--
Note: Please route any artifacts via the secure intake link below and mark items as "Novus_RFP42"
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: Lisa Wong <lisa.wong@novusfinancial.com>
Cc: mina.haddad@redwoodinference.com, marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com
Date: Sun, 11 Apr 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Novus SIG questionnaire (Q2) — initial intake

Lisa — thanks for sending this over and for the clear asks. We can follow the S3-staging + manifest approach; below is a compact plan so InfoSec has visibility.

High-level proposal (deliverable-oriented):
1) Artifact corridor (staging): We will provision a time-limited S3 staging bucket (read-only signed URLs for Novus reviewers) tagged Novus_RFP42. All artifacts will be accompanied by a CSV manifest with SHA256 hashes (example: Redwood_hash_manifest_v1.csv).
2) KMS provenance: We will provide a KMS provenance pack (kms_provenance_template.pdf) that includes key creation timestamps, rotation schedule, and HSM vendor attestations where applicable. If customer-managed keys are used, we will include the BYOK handoff log (timestamped).
3) Sample bundle: Initial packet will include 3 artifacts — (a) system audit log extract (tz-normalized), (b) retention policy excerpt and config snapshot, (c) access review screenshot with user mapping.
4) Intake & approvals: We prefer a single intake ticket via our secure intake folder (Drive link) and will create a DocuSign LOA for any time-limited read access.

Timeline (proposed):
- Day 0 (today): Ack + access/LOA template sent
- Day 2–4: KMS provenance pack + manifest v1 uploaded
- Day 5–7: Sample bundle (3 artifacts) delivered and validated by Novus
- Day 10: Full SIG mapping draft delivered

I'll loop in Mina and Marissa to assign owners; Mina will coordinate artifact extraction and Marissa will own the control mapping. If Novus needs an earlier canary upload for the KMS pack, we can prioritize.

Attachments: 
- (we will upload) Redwood_hash_manifest_v1.csv
- (we will provide) kms_provenance_template.pdf

Thanks — Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Director, Trust & Compliance | Redwood Inference

KMS provenance: We will provide HSM vendor attestations where HSMs are in use (vendor-signed PDFs) and a rotation history table with ISO8601/UTC timestamps. LOA & DocuSign: Marissa will send the LOA via DocuSign for the Novus reviewers to sign. The LOA will be scoped to read-only signed URLs for the staging bucket and a 30-day window (unless you request otherwise).

- Marissa Cole (marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com) — Control mapping and DocuSign LOA.
- Karthik Iyer — Single point escalation and timeline owner.
